title: Test a faulty count
prompt: Write catchesMissingLast(candidate): boolean. A correct candidate sums a number array; the broken candidate sums every element except the last. Return true when your test sees the correct result and false when it detects the defect. Call the supplied candidate on a distinguishing input.
hints: Compare the two behaviors on an empty list.
Choose an input where the final entry affects the answer.
Compute the expected answer independently of the candidate.
checks: (() => { let calls = 0; catchesMissingLast(xs => { calls++; return 0; }); return calls > 0; })()
feedback: Compare the two behaviors on an empty list.
